answer: Copying the same citations across 192 aliases thus pays the reading cost 192 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the zenith check immediately, the jetty audit keeps the resolved set and the yarrow replay publishes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
